card.name: Start of PATIENT and institution names
card.fires_on: Responds to the first piece of the word PATIENT in capitals, and to "at" or "Texas" before a named cancer center or university. It also fires on the start of "Patients" split mid-word.

modes.label: Capitalized PATIENT
modes.description: The opening piece "PAT" of PATIENT in all-caps headings such as PATIENT INFORMATION or PATIENT COUNSELING.

modes.label: Place before institution
modes.description: The word "at" or "Texas" just before a named university or cancer center where a study or protocol was done.
modes.example: clinical trials conducted<< at>> University of Texas M.D. Anderson Cancer

card.plain: It marks the spot where the word PATIENT begins in capitals, or where a research institution's name is about to follow.
